lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's fifteen feet? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 15 feet? Nope!

lines.text: A box, twelve tall and twelve deep, is against a wall. The ladder's foot is nine feet away.
lines.caption: A box, 12 tall and 12 deep, is against a wall. The ladder's foot is 9 feet away.

lines.text: It touches the box's top corner and reaches the wall. How long is it?
lines.caption: It touches the box's top corner and reaches the wall. How long is it?

lines.text: Nine across, twelve up. That's four up for every three across.
lines.caption: 9 across, 12 up. That's 4 up for every 3 across.

lines.text: The wall is twenty-one feet away. That's seven groups of three.
lines.caption: The wall is 21 feet away. That's 7 groups of 3.

lines.text: So the ladder rises seven groups of four. Twenty-eight feet up the wall!
lines.caption: So the ladder rises 7 groups of 4. 28 feet up the wall!

lines.text: That's a three, four, five triangle, times seven. So the ladder is thirty-five feet!
lines.caption: That's a 3-4-5 triangle, times 7. So the ladder is 35 feet!

lines.text: Fifteen was the trap. It stops at the box.
lines.caption: 15 was the trap. It stops at the box.

lines.text: Did you get thirty-five feet? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 35 feet? Tell me below!
